title: Premium Downtown Property! Amazing Rooftop 15 Beds
description:
NEWLY RENOVATED JUNE 2026! Roof top views of downtown Nashville and close to the heart of the action! 4 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms.   Tons of beds for plenty of sleeping options!  Light, modern, and airy! Perfect for a fun getaway or business travel! Walk to the Gulch!  Amazing rooftop!

The space
This well-designed home offers a layout that’s perfect for group travel while still providing plenty of privacy and comfort:

Multiple comfortable bedrooms with quality bedding
Modern bathrooms for convenience and ease during group stays
Open-concept living and dining areas ideal for gathering, relaxing, or entertaining
A fully equipped kitchen with everything needed for home-cooked meals or quick bites
High-speed Wi-Fi, great for remote work or streaming
Contemporary décor with a clean, welcoming Nashville vibe
Whether you’re heading out for live music or enjoying a quiet night in, this space is built to make your stay effortless and enjoyable.

This property has special local compliance requirements which include a signed rental agreement, ID verification, and a security hold of $1500 (which is not a traditional security deposit, just a pending transaction). As an optional alternative to the security hold, you may opt in to purchase a non-refundable damage waiver provided by a third-party insurance company. The optional damage waiver is $89 for stays up to 10 nights, with an additional $2 per day for stays longer than 10 nights. Damage waiver purchases are optional. 

To make this process easy for you, we use a secure and very simple, app-free platform called Happy Guest. It is not an app, and you do not have to sign up for an account - it’s a safe and secure website. It also gives you a guest portal with all the info about the home and all of my favorite local spots.

Guest access
Guests enjoy private, exclusive access to the entire home, including:

All bedrooms and bathrooms
Kitchen, living, and dining areas
Any outdoor or designated common areas associated with the home

Self check-in allows for a smooth and flexible arrival, so you can start enjoying your stay right away.
